Ingredients:

- 1 cup melted butter

- 2 cups sugar

- 1 cup cocoa powder

- 4 eggs

- 1 tsp vanilla extract

- 1.5 cups all-purpose flour

Instructions:

1. Preheat your oven to 180 degrees.

2. Mix the melted butter, sugar, and cocoa powder in a bowl.

3. Add the eggs and vanilla, then whisk until smooth.

4. Gently fold in the flour and mix until the batter is smooth.

5. Pour into a greased pan and bake for 25-30 minutes.

Wallpaper Engine is a widely popular desktop customization application available on Steam that allows users to create, download, and set interactive, animated, and dynamic 3D or 2D wallpapers. Deeply integrated with the Steam Workshop, it gives access to a virtually endless library of community-made backgrounds without consuming excessive system resources. Here’s a quick breakdown of its advantages and drawbacks.

+ Massive Community Library – Steam Workshop integration provides millions of free, high-quality animated wallpapers across all genres, styles, and themes.

+ Deep Customization & Creation Tools – Offers powerful built-in editor tools allowing users to convert images, videos, 3D models, or interactive HTML files into custom live wallpapers.

+ Highly Optimized Performance – Automatically pauses or reduces frame rates when playing full-screen games or applications to prevent performance drops.

+ Multi-Monitor & Mobile Support – Features full support for multi-monitor setups, ultra-wide resolutions, and includes a free companion app to transfer wallpapers to Android devices.

- Windows & Android Only – Lacks official support for macOS and Linux desktops.

- Vetted Content Filtering Needed – The sheer size of the Steam Workshop means browsing without filters can yield inconsistent quality or adult content.

- Resource Usage on Older Hardware – Complex 3D or web-rendered wallpapers can still draw noticeable GPU/CPU power on low-end systems if not configured properly.

Considering it's less than $10 for a huge library of high quality animated wallpapers, this is so easy to recommend, especially for anyone who wants to customize their PC.
